topic_zh: 生命周期入门：'a 到底在说什么

xhs.title: 这个函数为什么编译不过？'a 在说什么
xhs.body:
第 17 课：生命周期入门
fn longest(x: &str, y: &str) -> &str 编译不过（E0106）：编译器不知道返回的引用借自 x 还是 y
加上 'a：fn longest<'a>(x: &'a str, y: &'a str) -> &'a str，返回值的有效期不超过 x、y 里更短的那个
'a 不会让谁活得更久，它只描述关系，让编译器帮你拦住悬垂引用（E0597）
参数里只有一个引用时，编译器自动补上，不用写
考考你：fn first(x: &str, n: usize) -> &str { &x[..n] } 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

douyin.title: 一分钟搞懂 Rust 生命周期：'a 到底在说什么
douyin.body:
'a 是给有效期起的名字，描述返回值借自哪个参数，不改变寿命；只有一个引用参数时可以不写。
考考你：fn first(x: &str, n: usize) -> &str { &x[..n] } 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: Why won't this simple Rust function compile? Lifetimes and 'a in one minute. Quick quiz: fn first(x: &str, n: usize) -> &str { &x[..n] }  Does it compile? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: What 'a actually says in Rust
linkedin.body:
fn longest(x: &str, y: &str) -> &str fails with E0106: the signature doesn't say whether the result is borrowed from x or y.
fn longest<'a>(x: &'a str, y: &'a str) -> &'a str says it: the result is valid no longer than the shorter-lived of x and y.
A lifetime never makes a value live longer. It describes a relationship, so the compiler can reject dangling references (E0597).
With only one reference parameter, lifetime elision fills it in for you.
Quick quiz: fn first(x: &str, n: usize) -> &str { &x[..n] }  Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: fn first(x: &str, n: usize) -> &str { &x[..n] } 能编译吗？
quiz.q_en: fn first(x: &str, n: usize) -> &str { &x[..n] }  Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：能。参数里只有 x 是引用（n 是 usize，不是引用），编译器自动把返回值的生命周期和 x 绑定，等于 fn first<'a>(x: &'a str, n: usize) -> &'a str。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: yes. x is the only reference parameter (n is a usize), so lifetime elision ties the result to x: it means fn first<'a>(x: &'a str, n: usize) -> &'a str.
